name: week
title: AML this week
subtitle: What needs the compliance officer, worst first. Read-only. Changes are made by asking Claude Code.

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select item, entity, ref, detail, due_on as due from attention_queue order by rank, due_on nulls last, ref

sections.title: Reports not yet lodged
sections.sql: select form, ref, entity, customer, due_on as due, rule from report_deadlines where lodged_on is null order by due_on
sections.note: SAR and PTR go to the NZ Police FIU through goAML. SMR and TTR go to AUSTRAC Online. This page lodges nothing.

sections.title: Ongoing reviews due in 60 days
sections.sql: select code, name, entity, risk_rating as risk, next_review_on as due, days_left from review_schedule where next_review_on <= current_date + 60 order by next_review_on

name: customers
title: Customer risk register
subtitle: Every live customer, their risk, CDD level and what is still missing.

sections.title: Live customers
sections.sql: select code, name, entity, kind, risk_rating as risk, cdd_level as cdd, pep, id_verified_on as verified, owners, owners_unverified, sanctions_checked_on as sanctions, next_review_on as next_review from customer_register where status in ('onboarding','active') order by entity, case risk_rating when 'high' then 0 when 'medium' then 1 when 'low' then 2 else 3 end, code

sections.title: Gaps on customer files
sections.sql: select rule, severity, entity, ref, finding from compliance_findings where ref like 'C-%' or ref like 'IMP-%' order by severity, rule, ref

name: programme
title: The AML programme
subtitle: Risk assessment, programme review, audit or independent evaluation, officer reports and annual reports, per firm.

sections.title: Programme calendar
sections.sql: select entity, obligation, last_done, next_due, next_due - current_date as days_left, rule from programme_calendar order by next_due

sections.title: Staff with AML duties
sections.sql: select entity, name, role, vetted_on, last_trained, training_due from staff_register where active and aml_role order by entity, name

sections.title: Rules in force
sections.sql: select code, topic, value, unit, coalesce(applies_to, 'all') as applies_to, case when policy_default then 'your setting' else 'law' end as basis, source from rules order by jurisdiction, topic
sections.note: Rows marked 'your setting' are this system's defaults for what the law leaves to your programme. Change them with /customise.
